purpose: This codebase is for a film rental application, handling various operations such as customer management, film management, inventory management, and staff management.

ActorController.getActors: Retrieves a list of all actors

CategoryController.getCategories: Retrieves a list of all categories

CustomerController.getCustomers: Retrieves a list of all customers

FilmController.getFilms: Retrieves a list of all films
FilmController.rentFilm: Rents a film to a customer

StaffController.getInventoryCount: Retrieves the number of inventory items

complexity_notes.design_patterns: The codebase uses the Model-View-Controller (MVC) design pattern to separate concerns and improve maintainability.
complexity_notes.database_interactions: The codebase uses Spring Data JPA to interact with the database, providing a layer of abstraction and simplifying database operations.
complexity_notes.security: The codebase uses Spring Security to handle authentication and authorization, providing a robust and customizable security framework.
complexity_notes.testing: The codebase uses JUnit and Mockito to write unit tests, ensuring that the code is testable and reliable.
